summary.tldr: Bans exporting certain plastic waste to foreign countries for final disposal and makes breaking the ban an offence.
what_it_does: Defines “plastic waste” as any plastic type listed in new Schedule 7 of the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999.
Prohibits exporting plastic waste to foreign countries for final disposal.
Allows the Governor in Council, on the Minister’s recommendation, to add or remove plastic types from Schedule 7 by order.
Makes contravening the new export ban an offence under the Act.
Brings the changes into force 12 months after royal assent.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999.
